trans-unit.source: This app needs local network access when its integration features are configured accordingly.

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).

trans-unit.target: Se blocchi queste connessioni, l’app non invierà i report di crash allo sviluppatore. I report di crash sono gestiti da Sentry (sentry.io).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).

trans-unit.target: Se blocchi queste connessioni, non potrai acquistare o attivare una licenza Pro. Le licenze sono gestite da Paddle (paddle.com).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.target: Se blocchi queste connessioni, non riceverai notifiche sulle nuove versioni e non potrai aggiornare l’app tramite la sua interfaccia.

trans-unit.id: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.source: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.target: Puoi creare nell’app controlli personalizzati basati sulla rete (ad esempio, per controllare un dispositivo connesso alla rete come un televisore o un amplificatore). Questi controlli possono connettersi a qualsiasi host specificato sulla rete locale o su Internet. Se blocchi queste connessioni, questi controlli personalizzati non funzioneranno.

trans-unit.id:

trans-unit.source:
%@ must restart to apply the imported settings.
If you imported settings from a different installation, macOS display identifiers (UUIDs) may not match this installation. As a result, various imported settings may not get immediately applied to the connected displays.
Use the 'Transfer display settings' feature under all affected displays' additional settings to fix the identifier mismatch issue.
trans-unit.target:
%@ deve riavviarsi per applicare le impostazioni importate.
Se hai importato le impostazioni da un’altra installazione, gli identificatori dei display di macOS (UUID) potrebbero non corrispondere a quelli di questa installazione. Di conseguenza, alcune impostazioni importate potrebbero non essere applicate immediatamente ai display connessi.
Usa la funzione 'Trasferisci impostazioni del display' nelle impostazioni aggiuntive di ciascun display interessato per risolvere la mancata corrispondenza degli identificatori.

trans-unit.id:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.
Please reactivate this installation to continue using Pro features.
trans-unit.source:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.
Please reactivate this installation to continue using Pro features.
trans-unit.target:
**Problema di licenza %@ rilevato**
Questa installazione è stata disattivata da remoto oppure gli identificatori hardware sono cambiati dall’ultima attivazione della licenza. Questo potrebbe essere successo a causa di un aggiornamento hardware o di una migrazione a un nuovo dispositivo.
Si prega di riattivare questa installazione per continuare a utilizzare le funzionalità Pro.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - License activation alert. %@ is the app name; reactivation refers to this installation, not restarting the app.

trans-unit.id:
Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.
trans-unit.source:
Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.
trans-unit.target:
Vuoi davvero che l’app reimposti le impostazioni dello schermo di macOS? Il sistema si riavvierà dopo il ripristino.
La cancellazione della NVRAM rimuove anche le preferenze firmware di basso livello, come le impostazioni del disco di avvio e quelle relative all’avvio. macOS le ricreerà o reimposterà come appropriato dopo il riavvio.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Confirmation text shown before resetting macOS display settings. It explains that either reset restarts the Mac and warns that the optional NVRAM action also clears low-level firmware preferences such as startup-disk and boot settings, which macOS recreates or resets after restart.

trans-unit.id: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.source: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.target: Intervallo di luminanza esteso e 16 bpc per una maggiore precisione del colore (predefinito: 8 bpc, SDR). Con un profilo colore compatibile con HDR (`Display P3` consigliato), i contenuti HDR vengono preservati durante la duplicazione su un display HDR/EDR. Lo stream a schermo intero e la finestra PIP con `Filtri video` e `Pipeline filtri HDR` abilitati mostrano correttamente i contenuti HDR. È anche possibile applicare manualmente il tone mapping con un filtro `Esposizione` appropriato per distinguere luminanze HDR fino a 10.000 nit virtuali.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Help for the virtual screen HDR and 16-bit color setting. Backticked Video Filters, HDR Filter Pipeline and Exposure refer to localized UI controls; Display P3 is a color profile name.

Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.source: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.target: L’app applicherà l’EDID caricato quando questo display viene connesso. L’operazione causa uno sfarfallio dello schermo e un cambio di modalità se quella attuale non è disponibile con l’EDID aggiornato. Se il nuovo EDID contiene dati identificativi diversi (produttore, modello, numero di serie), il display verrà rilevato come un dispositivo diverso. Tieni premuto ⇧ Maiusc all’avvio per attivare la modalità sicura ed evitare l’applicazione automatica. In caso di problemi gravi, scollega e ricollega fisicamente il display per ripristinare l’EDID originale.

trans-unit.id: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). trans-unit.source: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). trans-unit.target: Il dispositivo non supporta il controllo del volume basato su intervalli (cioè impostare un livello specifico su una scala tra un minimo e un massimo). Il controllo del volume potrebbe non funzionare in modo ottimale se è collegato un ricevitore AV e HDMI-CEC gestisce il volume tra TV e ricevitore.

trans-unit.id: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.source: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.target: Ciò può essere dovuto al supporto DDC/CI disattivato (controllare l’OSD del display), a limitazioni del firmware del display o a problemi di connessione. Molti TV e monitor smart derivati dai TV non supportano DDC. Se il problema non può essere risolto modificando le impostazioni del display o correggendo problemi di connessione, è consigliabile disattivare il supporto DDC.

trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Quando l’upscaling HDR è abilitato e il controllo hardware della luminosità è disabilitato, l’app usa una scala continua tra zero e il valore massimo di upscaling calibrato. Il livello neutro (luminosità al 100⁠%, senza tagli ai livelli del contenuto HDR) potrebbe quindi non coincidere con una tacca dell’OSD, rendendolo difficile da raggiungere con le scorciatoie. Per questo viene inserito un passo aggiuntivo al 100⁠% di luminosità, all’interno della tacca.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Neutral software HDR brightness keyboard step setting help.

trans-unit.id: When this is enabled, the app will use the matching audio device's native audio controls (if available) instead of direct hardware control (via DDC or control integration). trans-unit.source: When this is enabled, the app will use the matching audio device's native audio controls (if available) instead of direct hardware control (via DDC or control integration). Make sure the matching audio device name is specified accordingly. This feature is useful for controlling the volume of multi-output audio devices involving both displays with app-managed hardware (DDC, control integration) volume control and displays with native volume control.

⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.
trans-unit.source:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.
trans-unit.target:
⚠️ Un’operazione di scrittura EDID modifica i dati EDID e DisplayID direttamente sul dispositivo. Dati EDID errati o un problema durante la scrittura EDID potrebbero rendere il display permanentemente inutilizzabile!
La maggior parte dei display non consente la scrittura EDID per motivi di sicurezza, mentre alcuni richiedono l’attivazione della scrittura EDID in un menu di servizio. La maggior parte degli emulatori EDID o dei dongle pass-thru supportano la scrittura EDID. La scrittura EDID (se supportata) funziona solitamente tramite HDMI.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Hardware EDID write warning. This changes device-stored identification data, not a software override.
